subject: SOC2 evidence review and next-step alignment for Skyline AI
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Elena McCann <elena.mccann@skyline.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Post-demo recap + SOC2 packet (attachments)

Elena — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and immediate next steps so your team has a single place to reference:

- Goal we heard: validate security posture and determine whether Redwood can be piloted for a small retraining workload this quarter (target POC by April).
- Key evaluation owners: Elena (infra lead), John (legal/compliance).
- Deliverables I promised: SOC2 evidence packet, short architecture write-up for data flows, and an ops contact for a follow-up 20-minute walkthrough.

Attached is the SOC2 packet (PDF) — it contains the control matrix, redacted logs sample, and our incident response summary. That should answer most of the standard checklist items but happy to pull any additional artifacts your team requests.

Next suggested steps:
1) Your team scans the packet and flags blockers or gaps — ideally by EOD Friday, 3/25.
2) If anything needs clarification, book a 20-minute slot here: https://calendly.com/redwood-ben/20min (Monica from CS is copied to join the walkthrough for operational questions).
3) If legal needs redacted artifacts, let me know what fields to mask and we’ll create a short bundle.

Attachments: [Redwood_SOC2_Packet_v1.4.pdf (1.2MB)]

Thanks — I’ll follow up mid-week if I haven’t heard back.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Redwood Inference | Production-first LLM inference for engineering teams

If it helps, Monica is available for a 20-minute live walkthrough and can surface operational artifacts (runbooks, backup policy excerpts) on the call. Open slots: Tue 3/23 11:00–12:30 or Wed 3/24 14:00–16:00 via https://calendly.com/redwood-ben/20min.

We want to keep the evaluation moving and are happy to adapt the packet or provide a short redacted artifact if legal needs that before the walkthrough.

Thanks — appreciate any update.

Best,
Ben

Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 16:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap + SOC2 packet (attachments) — quick check-in

Ben / Elena — reviewing now. A couple of items legal flagged that will be blockers unless clarified:

1) Data retention for ephemeral KV cache: need explicit retention windows and whether customer data persists in any long-term logs. Please confirm default retention and whether customers can opt into shorter retention or purging.
2) Third-party subprocessors list: we need the vendor list for any infra-level partners (monitoring, observability, cloud infra).

If you can provide short answers or a redacted artifact for the retention detail by EOD Wed (3/24) that would be ideal — otherwise legal may need an extra week. Also — if you have a redacted sample log (no PII) that shows TTL/purge behavior, please attach.

Thanks — John
John Park
Senior Counsel, Skyline AI
john.park@skyline.ai
